azure.dns.private.zone.note: Private DNS zone per month, the same in every public region (billing Zone 1); zones are billed pro rata by the hour. Volume tiers count the private zones of the subscription: the first 25 at the list price, every zone from the 26th lower ("First 25 hosted DNS zones"; zones and queries are aggregated within an Azure subscription for billing, https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/dns/)
